name: Lee's Marketplace Deli Rotisserie Chicken, Mashed Potatoes & Famous Glazed Donut
brandOrRestaurant: Lee's Marketplace (Logan / North Logan / Smithfield, UT)
whyItWorks: Lee's Marketplace hot deli offers plain herb-roasted rotisserie chicken and whipped mashed potatoes or Hawaiian rolls for an easy grocery meal, plus their famous airy glazed potato donuts in remission.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Grab a hot Plain or Traditional Rotisserie Chicken (remove the skin) and soft rolls from Lee's deli counter.
watchOuts: Remove seasoned chicken skin; save Lee's fried glazed donuts for remission and pair with protein
